thomas-baird.text: Per an AI-generated Citizen Portal summary of the March 10, 2026 appointment interviews, Baird told the board he would bring a "student-centered" approach prioritizing equity, collaboration and transparency, saying "I'm here for the kids, not just my own."

source.title: Citizen Portal (AI-generated meeting summary): East Whittier board appoints Thomas Baird to fill Area 4 vacancy (Mar. 10, 2026)

miguel-angel-hernandez-jr.text: Per an AI-generated Citizen Portal summary of the March 10, 2026 Area 4 appointment interviews, Miguel Hernandez, a district graduate, stressed support for staff and facilities and responding to community concerns; the board appointed Baird instead.

source.title: Citizen Portal (AI-generated meeting summary): East Whittier board appoints Thomas Baird to fill Area 4 vacancy (Mar. 10, 2026)

notes: Thin evidence for both: only an AI-generated meeting summary of the March 2026 appointment interviews (Hernandez there is described as a district graduate and community volunteer; assumed to be the same Miguel Angel Hernandez Jr. who later filed).
